## column management 

```{r}

meta_init$ActualWP = as.numeric(meta_init$ActualWP)
meta_init$ActualGWC = as.numeric(meta_init$ActualGWC)
#meta_init$ActualWP_MPa =   meta_init$ActualWP / 10
meta_init$`CO2 ug SOCg-1 h-1` = as.numeric(meta_init$`CO2 ug SOCg-1 h-1`)

meta_wmbc = merge(meta_init[,-1] , mbc, by = "CoreUniqueID")  # combine meta and mbc

# prpoer meta file
meta  = meta_wmbc %>% select(CoreUniqueID, SiteCode,RainTrt,FieldRep, TargetGWC, TargetWP,ActualGWC, ActualWP, MBC, `CO2 ug SOCg-1 h-1`) %>% 
  group_by(CoreUniqueID, SiteCode,RainTrt,FieldRep, TargetGWC, TargetWP,ActualGWC,ActualWP, MBC) %>% 
  summarize(CO2_eq = mean(`CO2 ug SOCg-1 h-1`, na.rm=T) ) # micrograms SOC per 

meta$logWP <- -log10(meta$ActualWP ) # log of WP, bars. 
meta$plot <- paste(meta$RainTrt, meta$FieldRep, sep = ".") # add column for plot 

# add coreuique id column for joining
counts_init$CoreUniqueID <- gsub(pattern = "_S[0-9].*", replacement = "", counts_init$SampleID)

# add qC02 column to meta
meta$qCO2 = meta$CO2_eq / meta$MBC

# subset just ukulinga. 
meta_new <- meta %>% filter(SiteCode == "ukulingadrt.za") 
quantile(meta_new$ActualWP, na.rm=T)

plot (meta_new $TargetGWC, meta_new$ActualGWC)

hist(meta_new$ActualWP)

library(ggridges)
meta_new %>% ggplot (aes (x = ActualWP, y = RainTrt, fill = RainTrt)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c( "#3281fb",  "#fb9900")) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    jittered_points = TRUE ,alpha = 0.5, scale = 1) + 
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ylab(NULL) +
   scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0) , limits=rev) 


meta_new %>% ggplot (aes (x = logWP, y = RainTrt, fill = RainTrt)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c( "#3281fb",  "#fb9900")) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    jittered_points = TRUE ,alpha = 0.5, scale = 1) + 
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ylab(NULL) +
   scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0) , limits=rev) 


meta_new$WP_categorical <- case_when(-meta_new$ActualWP>-15 ~ "wet",
                             -meta_new$ActualWP< -15 ~ "dry")

write.csv (meta_new, "Ukulinga_Metadata_full.csv", row.names = F)
```
# co2 flux with water potential in A and D
## look at co2 flux curves
```{r}
meta_new$graphlab = dplyr::recode(meta_new$RainTrt, Ambient="(a)" , Drought = "(b)")
co2_fig = meta_new %>% ggplot(aes(x=ActualWP, y=CO2_eq)) +  # much better
  geom_vline(xintercept = 15, linetype = "dashed", color = "pink") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  geom_point(aes (color = WP_categorical, shape = RainTrt), fill = "white", size = 2, stroke=1.25 ) +
  #geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "green") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 300), 
                  clip = 'off') +
  geom_text (aes (x = 500, y = 300, label = paste (graphlab, RainTrt, sep = " ")) ,hjust=0)  +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = ggforce::trans_reverser('log10'), labels = label_trueminus) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c ("#B2432FFF", "#3A6589FF") , name = "WP") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,24), name = "Trt") +
  theme_clean_mod() +
  annotate (geom = "text", label = "Dry", x = 50, y = 5, vjust=0, color = "#B2432FFF") +
  annotate (geom = "text", label = "Wet", x = 2, y = 5,vjust=0,  color = "#3A6589FF") +
  theme(
    strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white" )  ,
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.position = c(.2, .9),
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.box.just = "left", 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "italic"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "italic")) +
  labs(
         colour = "WP",
         shape = "Trt"
        ) +
  
  xlab( "Water potential (bars)")  +
  scale_y_continuous( expression(CO["2"]~flux ~ (mu~g/ gC / h))) +
  facet_grid(~RainTrt)


showtext_auto()
showtext_opts(dpi = 300)

co2_fig

# Create the filename with the date
fig1Name <- paste0("Figures/Figure_1_", current_date, ".png")

ggsave (fig1Name, co2_fig ,  width =7, height = 4, unit = "in", dpi = 300)

#
# Save as SVG
ggsave("Figures/Figure_1.svg", plot = co2_fig, width =7, height = 4, dpi = 300)

```

### models for CO2 flux

```{r}
mod_forflux = lmer(CO2_eq~poly(logWP,2)*RainTrt + (1|plot), data =meta_new)
summary(mod_forflux) # this says the linear is fine, no quad, nointeraction....

mod_forflux_cat = lmer(CO2_eq~WP_categorical*RainTrt + (1|plot), data =meta_new)  # using category
summary(mod_forflux_cat)
pairs(emmeans(mod_forflux_cat, pairwise~RainTrt|WP_categorical , infer=T))
pairs(emmeans(mod_forflux_cat, pairwise~WP_categorical|RainTrt , infer=T)) # again - WP, not treatment

 
mod_forflux_lin = lmer(CO2_eq~logWP*RainTrt + (1|plot), data =meta_new) # linear only model
summary(mod_forflux_lin ) # this says the linear is fine, no trt, no interaction....
r.squaredGLMM(mod_forflux_lin) 

mod_formbc = lmer(MBC~poly(logWP,2)*RainTrt + (1|plot), data =meta_new) 
summary(mod_formbc ) # no trend. 
r.squaredGLMM(mod_formbc)
```

# Set up analyses for transcript abundance
## merge files 

```{r}
counts = merge (counts_init, meta_new, by = "CoreUniqueID")
setdiff( meta_new$CoreUniqueID, unique (gsub ( "_S.*", "" , counts_init$CoreUniqueID) ) )
# playing around -counts correlated with WP?
counts_total_eachwp = counts %>% group_by(ActualWP) %>% summarize(sum = sum(deseq_counts)) 
plot(counts_total_eachwp$ActualWP, counts_total_eachwp$sum) # hmmm
plot(-log(counts_total_eachwp$ActualWP), counts_total_eachwp$sum) # better
cor.test(-log(counts_total_eachwp$ActualWP), counts_total_eachwp$sum) # good. 

# get rid groups we dont care about! Human related
# RIGHT NOW ALSO TAKINGOUT global and overview maps!!!! too broad to be useful...
ko_level2 <-  ko_level2_init  %>%  filter ( Level.1 != "Human Diseases"  &
                                              Level.1 != "Drug Development" &
                                              Level.2 != "Global and overview maps" &
                                              Level.2 != "Immune system" &
                                              Level.2 != "Information processing in viruses" &
                                              Level.2 != "Infectious disease: viral" &
                                              Level.2 != "Circulatory system" &
                                              Level.2 != "Endocrine system" &
                                              Level.2 != "Digestive system" &
                                              Level.2 != "Excretory system")

ko_level2$Level.2 = dplyr::recode (ko_level2$Level.2, "Cellular community - prokaryotes" = "Biofilm production")

length(unique(ko_level2$Level.2))
spor2 = as.data.frame(spor$KO)
names(spor2)[1] = "KO"
spor2$Level.2 = "Sporulation"
ko_level2_wspore = rbind((ko_level2 %>% select(KO,Level.2)), spor2)

#sporgrep = ko_desc %>% filter(grepl("porulation",ko_description) )

# merge KO counts with LEVEL 2 assignments
ko_counts_lev2 = merge(counts, ko_level2_wspore, by = "KO")


# finally, count up relative abundance for each level 2 within each sample
# ..... do we want to do relative abundance???? consider just using sum. 
totalcounts_wlevel2 = ko_counts_lev2 %>% group_by(SampleID,RainTrt, plot,logWP,ActualWP,  WP_categorical,MBC,qCO2,CO2_eq) %>% summarize(totalLev2Counts = sum(deseq_counts))

lev2_sums_init = ko_counts_lev2 %>% group_by(SampleID,Level.2) %>% summarize(Lev2Count = sum(deseq_counts))

lev2_sums = merge(lev2_sums_init, totalcounts_wlevel2 )
lev2_sums$relabun = lev2_sums$Lev2Count / lev2_sums$totalLev2Counts * 100

plot(lev2_sums$Lev2Count, lev2_sums$relabun) # okay so pretty damn close
cor.test(lev2_sums$Lev2Count, lev2_sums$relabun) # 99 percent correlation. 

```

## correlation to remove extremely highly correlated categories - redundant?

```{r}
Lev2 = unique(lev2_sums$Level.2)

lev2_sums_wide <- lev2_sums  %>% 
  dplyr::select (c(SampleID, RainTrt, logWP, ActualWP, WP_categorical,CO2_eq, qCO2, Level.2, Lev2Count)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Level.2", values_from = "Lev2Count", values_fill = 0)

lev2_sums_sitexsp = lev2_sums_wide %>% select(all_of(Lev2)) %>% as.matrix()
rownames(lev2_sums_sitexsp) = lev2_sums_wide$SampleID
lev2_sums_wide_meta = lev2_sums_wide %>% select(!all_of(Lev2))

# look at correlation plot between the functions !!!!
res <- cor(lev2_sums_sitexsp)

res[!lower.tri(res)] <- 0
max(res)  # 0.9882873 !!
res[abs(res)>0.95] #0.9702878 0.9531871 0.9882873
res[abs(res)>0.9] # more. 

lev2_sums_sitexsp_nocor <- 
  lev2_sums_sitexsp[, !apply(res, 2, function(x) any(abs(x) > 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))]
dim(lev2_sums_sitexsp)
dim(lev2_sums_sitexsp_nocor) # this takes out three
colnames(lev2_sums_sitexsp)
colnames(lev2_sums_sitexsp_nocor) # no aging,  no chromosome , these are good ones to get rid of 
setdiff(colnames(lev2_sums_sitexsp), colnames(lev2_sums_sitexsp_nocor))

# make long that also has no cor. 
lev2_sums_nocor = lev2_sums %>% filter(Level.2 %in%  colnames(lev2_sums_sitexsp_nocor))
dim(lev2_sums)
dim(lev2_sums_nocor)
length(unique(lev2_sums$Level.2))
length(unique(lev2_sums_nocor$Level.2))

#GGally::ggpairs(lev2_sums_sitexsp_nocor) +theme_bw()
```
## create a site x species matrix. species = KEGG KO geness
```{r}

goodmeta_names = c("SampleID","RainTrt","logWP","WP_categorical", "CO2_eq","qCO2", "plot")
# do not limit only to ones with level 2
sitexsp_wmeta <- counts %>% dplyr::select(c(SampleID,RainTrt,logWP,WP_categorical,CO2_eq,qCO2,plot,KO,deseq_counts)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from=KO, values_from = deseq_counts, values_fill = 0)

ko_list = unique(counts$KO)

sitexsp <- sitexsp_wmeta %>% select(all_of(ko_list))
#column_to_rownames(sitexsp$SampleID)

sitexsp_metadata <- sitexsp_wmeta %>% select(all_of(goodmeta_names))
```

# NMDS and permanova
```{r}
keep_genes = colSums (sitexsp!=0) > 3
table( keep_genes) # this is correct. 

length(names(keep_genes[keep_genes==TRUE]))
keep_genes_true = names(keep_genes[keep_genes==TRUE])
sitexsp_abun <- sitexsp %>% dplyr::select(all_of(keep_genes_true))

dim(sitexsp) # 12426, now 12295
dim(sitexsp_abun) # 7593, 7469

# here, toggle between using all genes and only sig genes from deseq
sitexsp_hel <- decostand(sitexsp_abun, method = "hellinger")
sitexsp_bray <- vegdist(sitexsp_hel, method = "bray")

# actual test
ko_perm <- adonis2(sitexsp_bray~sitexsp_metadata$logWP*sitexsp_metadata$RainTrt, permutations = 19999)
ko_perm # logwp matter a lot
cbind (ko_perm[1], ko_perm$R2)
ko_perm$R2

ko_perm_WP_categorical <- adonis2(sitexsp_bray~sitexsp_metadata$WP_categorical*sitexsp_metadata$RainTrt, permutations = 19999)
ko_perm_WP_categorical # also sig as category

# pairwise 
ko_perm_WP_categorical_pairwise  = pairwiseAdonis::pairwise.adonis(sitexsp_bray, factors=paste(sitexsp_metadata$WP_categorical,sitexsp_metadata$RainTrt))

# beta dispersion
betadisper_WP_categorical = betadisper(sitexsp_bray, group=paste(sitexsp_metadata$WP_categorical,sitexsp_metadata$RainTrt) )
anova(betadisper_WP_categorical) # N/S

# NMDS!
nmds= metaMDS(sitexsp_hel, distance = "bray", trymax = 100, wascores =TRUE)
#nmds$species
#sppscores(nmds) <- sitexsp_hel
nmds$stress
goodness(nmds)

nmds_ggplot <- sitexsp_metadata
nmds_ggplot$NMDS1 <- scores(nmds)$sites[,1]
nmds_ggplot$NMDS2 <- scores(nmds)$sites[,2]
```

```{r, fig.height=5.25, fig.width=12.5}
# this is ordihull. 
ggordiplot_nmds = gg_ordiplot(nmds, groups = paste (nmds_ggplot$RainTrt, nmds_ggplot$WP_categorical) ,

# select species scores using ordiselect
limited <- goeveg::ordiselect( goeveg::clean_matrix (sitexsp_hel ), 
                               nmds, method = "axes", ablim = 0.2, fitlim = 0.25)

nmdss.sp.scores = as.data.frame (nmds$species  )
nmdss.sp.scores = rownames_to_column(nmdss.sp.scores, var = "KO")
nmdss.sp.scores_wdesc = merge(nmdss.sp.scores, ko_desc, by = "KO")
nmdss.sp.scores_wdesc$short = gsub("\\;.*", "", nmdss.sp.scores_wdesc$ko_description)

nmdss.sp.scores2_lev2 = merge(nmdss.sp.scores_wdesc, ko_level2, by = "KO", all.x = T)

# this is top 26 genes based on ordiselect! colored by level 2. 
nmdss.sp.scores2_lev2_norepeats  = nmdss.sp.scores2_lev2 %>% group_by(KO) %>% top_n(n=1)
```

# DESEQ2 results 

## gene-level results: bring in  DESEQ2 results 

```{r}
deseq_all_init = read.csv("L2/DESeq2_genes_ALL_00721.csv")
deseq_all= merge(deseq_all_init, ko_desc, by = "KO", all.x =T)

deseq_all$sig =  if_else (deseq_all$padj<0.05 & abs(deseq_all$log2FoldChange )>= 0.5  , "sig","ns")
table (deseq_all$sig)
deseq_all$posorneg <- case_when(deseq_all$log2FoldChange>0 ~ "pos",
                                deseq_all$log2FoldChange<0 ~ "neg")

deseq_all$short = gsub(",.*", "", gsub("\\;.*", "", deseq_all$ko_description))


deseq_all_amb_lin =  deseq_all %>% filter(TrtSig=="Ambient" & Term == "Linear") 
deseq_all_amb_quad =  deseq_all %>% filter(TrtSig=="Ambient" & Term == "Quadratic") 
deseq_all_drt_lin =  deseq_all %>% filter(TrtSig=="Drought" & Term == "Linear") 
deseq_all_drt_quad =  deseq_all %>% filter(TrtSig=="Drought" & Term == "Quadratic") 

# subset for SIG based on cutoff! i did LFC 0.5 and alpha 0.5 in results function 
deseq_sig_gwc =deseq_all %>% filter(padj<0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange )> 0.5 )

write.csv (deseq_sig_gwc ,"List of DEGs Supplemental.csv",  row.names = F )

deseq_sig_gwc %>% group_by(posorneg, TrtSig) %>% dplyr::count()  


# link with level 2
ko_level2_wspore_nocor =  ko_level2_wspore  %>% filter (Level.2 %in% lev2_sums_nocor$Level.2 )
deseq_sig_gwc_wLev2 <- merge(deseq_sig_gwc , ko_level2_wspore_nocor , by = "KO", all.x=TRUE) # merge with KO

write.csv (deseq_sig_gwc_wLev2 ,"List of DEGs Supplemental_lev2.csv",  row.names = F )


```

#Analysis of KEGG level 2 gene functional categoriess 

## LINEAR MODEL for level 2 analysis!!!!

```{r}
strictControl <- lmerControl(optCtrl = list(
  algorithm = "NLOPT_LN_NELDERMEAD",
  xtol_abs = 1e-12,
  ftol_abs = 1e-12))

megamod_lin <- lmer(Lev2Count~ Level.2*logWP*RainTrt + (1|plot) , data = lev2_sums_nocor,  REML=FALSE , control = strictControl)

#summary(megamod_lin)
car::Anova(megamod_lin, type = "III") # level2 * logWP
r.squaredGLMM(megamod_lin)

# emmeans post-hoc looking at linear - trends with wp
megamod_lin_emtrends_WP = emtrends(megamod_lin,  ~ Level.2, var = "logWP",  infer=TRUE)  %>% as_tibble() #THIS IS WHAT I WANT !!!
megamod_lin_emtrends_WP$p.forfig = case_when(megamod_lin_emtrends_WP$p.value > 0.001 ~ paste ("=", round (megamod_lin_emtrends_WP$p.value, 3) ),
                                              megamod_lin_emtrends_WP$p.value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001" )
megamod_lin_emtrends_WP_sig = megamod_lin_emtrends_WP %>% filter (p.value<0.05)

# emmeans post-hoc looking at linear -  do the SLOPES differ woth raintrt?
megamod_lin_emtrends_WP_avsD =emtrends(megamod_lin,  pairwise~RainTrt|Level.2, var = "logWP", infer=TRUE) 
megamod_lin_emtrends_WP_avsD_sig = megamod_lin_emtrends_WP_avsD$contrasts %>% as.data.frame () %>% filter (p.value < 0.1)

megamod_lin_emtrends_WP_avsD_sig$p.forfig = case_when(megamod_lin_emtrends_WP_avsD_sig$p.value > 0.001 ~ paste ("=", round (megamod_lin_emtrends_WP_avsD_sig$p.value, 3) ),
                                                      megamod_lin_emtrends_WP_avsD_sig$p.value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001" )
# NONE DIFFER !!!! when measured this way....

#  emmeans post-hoc looking at linear - do the MEANS differ with raintrt??
megamod_lin_emmeans_emm = emmeans(megamod_lin,  pairwise~RainTrt|Level.2, var = "logWP")
megamod_lin_emmeans_avsD =emmeans(megamod_lin,  pairwise~RainTrt|Level.2, var = "logWP", infer=TRUE) 
megamod_lin_emmeans_avsD_sig = megamod_lin_emmeans_avsD$contrasts %>% as.data.frame () %>% filter (p.value < 0.1)
megamod_lin_emmeans_avsD_sig$p.value
megamod_lin_emmeans_avsD_sig$p.forfig = case_when(megamod_lin_emmeans_avsD_sig$p.value > 0.001 ~ paste ("=", round (megamod_lin_emmeans_avsD_sig$p.value, 3) ),
                                                  megamod_lin_emmeans_avsD_sig$p.value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001" )


```

## QUADRATIC level 2 model 
```{r}
megamod_quad <- lmer(Lev2Count~Level.2*poly(logWP,2)*RainTrt + (1|plot)   , data = lev2_sums_nocor,  REML=FALSE , control = strictControl) #lmer #+ (1|plot)  + (1|Level.2)

#summary(megamod_quad )
#car::Anova(megamod_quad , type = "III")
anova(megamod_quad ,  megamod_lin)
r.squaredGLMM(megamod_quad)
AICc(megamod_lin, megamod_quad) # this says go with the quaadratic
AICctab(megamod_lin, megamod_quad) # this says go with the quadratic

# looking at  quadratic - trends with wp (across treatments)
megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_init = emtrends(megamod_quad,  ~ Level.2, var = "logWP", max.degree=2, infer=TRUE)  #THIS IS WHAT I WANT !!!
megamod_quad_emtrends_WP = test (megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_init )
megamod_quad_emtrends_WP$p.forfig = case_when(megamod_quad_emtrends_WP$p.value > 0.001 ~ paste ("=", round (megamod_quad_emtrends_WP$p.value, 3) ),
                                                  megamod_quad_emtrends_WP$p.value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001" )

# do the shapes of the curves differ with raintrt? - emtrends
megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_avsD_full =emtrends(megamod_quad,  ~RainTrt|Level.2, var = "logWP", max.degree=2) 
megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_avsD_full
coef (megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_avsD_full)
#megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_avsD_full@model.info$model.matrix
megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_avsD =emtrends(megamod_quad,  pairwise~RainTrt|Level.2, var = "logWP", max.degree=2, infer=TRUE) 
megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_avsD_sig = megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_avsD$contrasts %>% as.data.frame () %>% filter (p.value < 0.1)

# do the means  differ with raintrt? - emmeans
megamod_quad_emmeans_avsD =emmeans(megamod_quad,  pairwise~RainTrt|Level.2, var = "logWP", max.degree=2, infer=TRUE) 
megamod_quad_emmeans_avsD_sig = megamod_quad_emmeans_avsD$contrasts %>% as.data.frame () %>% filter (p.value < 0.1)

# list of sig for figures
megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_sig = megamod_quad_emtrends_WP %>% filter (p.value<0.1)

megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_NOTsig = megamod_quad_emtrends_WP %>% filter (p.value>0.05) # list of those that are not sig
megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_quad = megamod_quad_emtrends_WP %>% filter(p.value<0.05 & degree == "quadratic") # list of those w/sig quadratic
megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_lin = megamod_quad_emtrends_WP %>% filter(p.value<0.05 &  # list of those w/sig linear but NOT quadratic.
                                                                     degree == "linear" & 
                                                                     !Level.2 %in% megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_quad$Level.2)




```
## getting model fits for plotting 

```{r}
# plot model predictions - quadraatic
plotdata_quad = emmip(
  megamod_quad, 
  ~RainTrt~logWP|Level.2 ,
  CIs = FALSE,
  at = list(logWP = c(-3, -2.5, -2, -1.5, -1, -0.5, 0))) # quadratic

plotdata_lin = emmip(
  megamod_lin, 
  ~RainTrt~logWP|Level.2 ,
  CIs = FALSE,
  at = list(logWP = c(-3, -2.5, -2, -1.5, -1, -0.5, 0))) # linear

# quad - significant
plotdata_quad_sela <- plotdata_quad$data 
plotdata_quad_sel <- plotdata_quad_sela %>% filter(Level.2 %in% megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_quad$Level.2)
plotdata_quad_sel$ActualWP =10 ^(-plotdata_quad_sel$logWP)

# lin - significant linear fit but in quad model
plotdata_lin_sela <- plotdata_lin$data
plotdata_lin_sel <- plotdata_lin_sela %>% filter(Level.2 %in% megamod_quad_emtrends_WP_lin$Level.2)
plotdata_lin_sel$ActualWP =10 ^(-plotdata_lin_sel$logWP)

# significant linear fit (linear model, no quadratic term)
plotdata_lin_sel_forlinfig <- plotdata_lin$data
plotdata_lin_sel_forlinfig_good <- plotdata_lin_sel_forlinfig %>% filter(Level.2 %in% megamod_lin_emtrends_WP_sig$Level.2)
plotdata_lin_sel_forlinfig_good$ActualWP =10 ^(-plotdata_lin_sel_forlinfig_good$logWP)
```

```{r, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 11}
my_fn <- function(data, mapping, method="p", use="pairwise", ...){
  
  # grab data
  x <- eval_data_col(data, mapping$x)
  y <- eval_data_col(data, mapping$y)
  
  # calculate correlation
  corr <- cor(x, y, method=method, use=use)
  
  # calculate colour based on correlation value
  # Here I have set a correlation of minus one to blue, 
  # zero to white, and one to red 
  # Change this to suit: possibly extend to add as an argument of `my_fn`
  colFn <- colorRampPalette(c("red", "white", "blue"), interpolate ='spline')
  fill <- colFn(100)[findInterval(corr, seq(-1, 1, length=100))]
  
  ggally_cor(data = data, mapping = mapping, colour = I("black"),size =4, ...) + 
    theme_void(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill=fill),
          strip.background = element_rect(linetype = 0), strip.text = element_text())
}
```
